description: This file defines the class RequestDeserializer, a custom Jackson deserializer for various types of Request objects used in a ZigBee request handling system. It parses JSON input to instantiate specific request classes based on the 'request' field in the input JSON.

classes.name: RequestDeserializer
classes.description: A Jackson StdDeserializer for the Request class hierarchy that interprets JSON data and creates appropriate Request subclasses based on the 'request' type specified in JSON.

methods.name: RequestDeserializer
methods.description: Constructs a new RequestDeserializer, optionally with a specific class type.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Overridden method that reads JSON input and instantiates specific Request objects based on the 'request' field.
